0022600187.text: The Suns (1-5, on a four-game losing streak and 12th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (2-5, on a two-game skid and 12th in the East) in Phoenix's seventh game of the season, with Phoenix 4.5 games back in the Pacific and Orlando 2 games back in the Southeast. Phoenix will be without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and is listed as day-to-day with Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), while Orlando's absences are Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Phoenix loss in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
